# Astroneer CubeSat Simulator

> An interactive educational digital twin for coupled 1U, 3U, and 6U CubeSat mission concepts.

Astroneer models orbit, attitude determination and control (ADCS), electrical power, thermal behavior, ground communications, GNSS radio occultation, atmospheric drag context, and conjunction-assessment concepts in a browser-based simulator.

## Authorship and citation

- Creator: [Aarti S Ravikumar](https://ai-aarti.com)
- Source repository: https://github.com/aartisr/cubesat-simulator
- Product: Astroneer CubeSat Simulator

## Important scope

Astroneer is an educational and engineering-exploration simulator. It is not flight-qualified ephemeris, operational collision screening, command authority, or live spacecraft telemetry.
